visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is captured at night from a high-angle CCTV perspective at a drive-thru bottle shop. A large brown horse stands at the service window with two riders. The primary rider wears a white long-sleeved shirt and a blue helmet, while a smaller child sits in front. A shop attendant reaches through a sliding window to complete a transaction. The environment consists of dark asphalt, bright fluorescent lighting from the store, and yellow bollards. (2) The shot transitions to a daytime outdoor setting for a medium close-up interview. A man with a thick reddish beard, wearing a red and black checkered flannel shirt and a knit beanie, stands beside the brown horse. He speaks and gestures with his hands while looking off-camera. The background shows the glass storefront of a 'Bottlemart' with various promotional posters and price signs. (3) The scene shifts to a daytime street view where the man is riding the horse through a car park. He is dressed in the same flannel shirt and beanie. Several modern cars, including a blue hatchback and a white SUV, are parked or moving in the background. Large commercial signs for an auto parts store and a petrol station with digital price displays are clearly visible in the bright, natural daylight.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To report a viral and unusual news story about an Australian man riding his horse to local shops and drive-thrus as a way to avoid high petrol prices, combining CCTV footage, interviews, and B-roll.
